For low testosterone: approved TRT and its prices first, then what the peptides sold for it really are.

Testosterone is FDA approved only for men with low testosterone from a medical condition, and it is not a peptide. No peptide is approved to raise testosterone in men without such a condition.

  • Pharmacy-made testosterone · pharmacy-made cream from online clinicsNot FDA approved; pharmacy-madeon prescription

    A cream or gel mixed by a pharmacy, from online clinics on prescription. Not an FDA-approved product.

    Testosterone mixed by a compounding pharmacy for one patient, sold by online clinics as part of a TRT plan. The FDA does not check these batch by batch. 10

    Not FDA approved; pharmacy-made.

    Prescription through the clinic.

    On prescription; no clinic prices yet
  • Enclomiphene · pharmacy-made pill for low testosteroneNot FDA approved; pharmacy-madeon prescription

    A pill some online clinics prescribe for low testosterone. Pharmacy-made, not FDA approved for any use.

    A pill some clinics prescribe for low testosterone. It is not FDA approved for any use, so only pharmacies make it. 11

    Not FDA approved; pharmacy-made.

    Prescription through the clinic.

    On prescription; no clinic prices yet
  • hCG and gonadorelin from online shops · research-use vials sold for testosteroneNot an approved productresearch use only

    Vials labelled for lab use, no prescription. Not approved products; gonadorelin's approved versions are discontinued.

    Sold by research-use shops to raise testosterone or keep the testes working during TRT. Not approved products: no dose control, no checks. 17

    Not an approved product.

    Research-use shops, with our checks.

    No listings yet
  • Kisspeptin-10 · vials sold for testosteroneNot approvedresearch use only

    A peptide sold for testosterone, in vials labelled for lab use. Not approved for any use.

    A peptide that signals the brain to release the hormones that start testosterone production. Not approved; the FDA lists it among substances that may be a significant safety risk in compounding. 18

    Not approved for any use.

    Research-use shops, with our checks.

    No listings yet
  • Testosterone (TRT) · shot or gel for low testosteroneFDA approvedon prescription

    A shot, gel or cream on prescription. Not a peptide. Approved only for men with low testosterone from a medical condition.

    Replaces a hormone the body makes too little of. Not FDA approved for low testosterone without an associated medical condition. 10

    FDA approved only for low testosterone with an associated medical condition.

    Prescription, after blood tests.

    On prescription; no clinic prices yet
  • hCG (Pregnyl, Novarel) · approved shot for pituitary-related low testosteroneFDA approvedon prescription

    A peptide hormone shot on prescription. Approved for some men whose low testosterone comes from the pituitary.

    A hormone shot that tells the testes to make testosterone. FDA approved for selected cases of low testosterone caused by the pituitary, not for TRT in general. 16

    FDA approved for selected cases of pituitary-related low testosterone.

    Prescription.

    On prescription; no clinic prices yet
